description: Evidence-required completion plus a test-modification guard and flake triage. post-bash writes a verification stamp when a test or build command passes; post-bash-failure CLEARS it when one fails and records the failure, because Claude Code delivers a failing Bash call on PostToolUseFailure and not on PostToolUse — a gap that let a commit through after a red suite (INC-0025) and left flake triage inert (INC-0024). edit-tracker clears the stamp when a file changes; verify-gate refuses a commit without a fresh one, and refuses a flaky one unless the flake is declared and carried in a Flaky: trailer; guard-test-changes refuses to modify an existing test or test config without a declaration naming it. The stamp trio resolves through stamp-path.sh, the guard classifies paths through classify-test-paths.sh, and both post-bash hooks decide what counts as a test run through classify-test-commands.sh — the runner patterns and wrapper rule are shared rather than copied, so neither hook can drift from the other on what a test command looks like; each still applies its own rules around that. check-test-changes.sh, check-flaky-trailers.sh, check-plugin-version.sh and check-record.sh are CI halves invoked by your workflow, not by a hook. Naming convention: implementation files are named for what they do; every file named test-* is a control suite and nothing else.
